# BaTip

> Official website for BaTip's focused utility apps, with product pages, task guides, and support and privacy links.

BaTip builds focused apps for learning, practice, and everyday utility.

## Apps

- [Hi Morse](https://batip.app/en/apps/hi-morse/): Morse code trainer with text-to-Morse conversion, decoder, audio playback, code table, listening practice, keyer, and flash.
- [Hi Morse Morse code converter and decoder](https://batip.app/en/apps/hi-morse/morse-code-converter/): browser tool for converting text to International Morse code and decoding written dot-and-dash patterns back to text.
- [Hi Eye](https://batip.app/en/apps/hi-eye/): Eye break reminder for screen work with a work-and-rest timer, guided breaks, browser reminders, and local progress.
- [Hi Eye eye break reminder guide](https://batip.app/en/apps/hi-eye/eye-break-reminder/)
- [Hi Eye tired eyes guide](https://batip.app/en/apps/hi-eye/reduce-tired-eyes/)
- [Hi Eye work and rest timer guide](https://batip.app/en/apps/hi-eye/work-rest-timer/)
- [Hi Memo](https://batip.app/en/apps/hi-memo/): Local-first notes app with optional Google Drive sync and Firebase Crashlytics diagnostics on Android and iOS.
